L4_llm.grounding_rule_rationale: Claim '3.1416' asserts 4-decimal precision (half-ULP 5e-5) yet 1% relative on 3.1415 is 3.1e-2, 630x wider than promised. Percent claims must be compared in percent space: 10.5% vs 0.1 fraction source previously applied 0.05 in fraction space instead of 0.05% (0.0005) and was 100x too wide. Rounding source to declared precision in display space is unit-consistent: accepts 0.12 <- 0.1234 (rounded to 2 decimals) and rejects 3170 vs 3180 and 3.1416 vs 3.1415. No relative tolerance is used; tolerance is the half-unit implied by the claim's own declared precision.
